$Comment: The race for the first trophy grimoire on the server: Meta.mmoskilltree.ServerFirst true means only the first player to satisfy the criterion keeps it, and Announce carries both a title and a body so the whole server hears who. It is a feat of strength: Listing.Feat lists it in the earned-only feats section, and Scoring gives it no points and keeps it out of the points total, so a player who never wins the race can still reach every points milestone. Its Auto reward unlocks the First Disenchanter title (Server/ZiggfreedCommon/Titles/MMOSkillTree/First_Disenchanter.json) the moment it is earned. The criterion is the same exact-id station output the Disenchanter achievement counts, qualified to 'Disenchanting_Table' on PREFIX so either table counts.
Name: Disenchanter_Server_First
